translations.web: I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.
translations.bsb: I have revealed Your name to those You have given Me out of the world. They were Yours; You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.
translations.kjv: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.
